description: Wire concrete VSAM record ops (KSDS keyed, RRDS relative, ESDS append-stable-address) under the DatasetAccess contract, over the EXISTING ff-vfs::StorageProvider backends (SqliteRecordProvider/SqliteRrdsProvider/NativeEsdsProvider), replacing the DatasetError::NotYetWired stubs in dataset_access/impl_io.rs point_impl. Implement a concrete VsamService (CatalogVsamService) and the point/get/put VSAM paths. VSAM stays a CLUSTER ENTITY (VsamCluster), never a Dsorg variant. Design decision: the byte-only StorageProvider seam cannot carry keyed ops, so introduce an in-crate VsamBackend enum that owns the typed backends directly (legal inside ff-dscatalog; preserves the DAG; adds no new backend and no public-trait widening). Delivers dataset-catalog Task 41.1, Req 34.1/34.2/35.3, ownership Req 22.3. MUST land before FEAT-003 (Req 35.3 ordering: VSAM wired before the crate is retired).
steps: READ .agents/tasks/rcb7-vsam-wiring/context.json and this FEAT file FIRST; context.json replaces re-exploration.

Add crates/ff-dscatalog/src/vsam_backend.rs (new module, declared in lib.rs): enum VsamBackend { Ksds(SqliteRecordProvider), Esds(NativeEsdsProvider), Rrds(SqliteRrdsProvider) } with open_for(root,&Path, Uuid, VsamType, &VsamParams)->Result<Self,VsamError> (KSDS uses KsdsKeyDefinition::new(key_offset,key_length) from params; LDS -> VsamError::UnsupportedOperation with a documented reason) and thin typed methods get_keyed/put_keyed/delete_keyed/browse_from/get_relative/put_relative/append_entry/sequential mapping CatalogError->VsamError. Keep <400 non-test lines; tests in vsam_backend_tests.rs if nearing ~200 lines.

Write FAILING unit tests first (vsam_backend_tests.rs or inline): KSDS keyed read-after-write round-trip; RRDS RRN round-trip incl. RRN 0 rejected; ESDS append insertion-order; KSDS alt-index lookup. Confirm RED via scoped test, then implement to GREEN.

Add crates/ff-dscatalog/src/vsam_service_impl.rs (new, declared+re-exported in lib.rs): struct CatalogVsamService backed by VsamBackend implementing the reconciled VsamService trait (create_*/initialize_dataset provision a backend; open->VsamHandle in a handle map; get/put/delete dispatch keyed/relative; start_browse/next_record/end_browse iterate sequential/browse_from; define_aix/build_index via SqliteRecordProvider alt-index for KSDS else UnsupportedOperation). Record boundaries come from the backend, never host text lines. Tests FIRST in vsam_service_impl_tests.rs. Keep vsam_service.rs (trait+stub) unchanged except re-exports and <400 lines.

Replace the NotYetWired branches in dataset_access/impl_io.rs point_impl: Positioner::Key positions a KSDS cluster by key; Positioner::Rrn positions an RRDS cluster by RRN (reject 0 -> BadPositioner); after a successful point, get_impl/put_impl operate at that position via the backend (KSDS keyed read/write; RRDS relative read/write; ESDS append-stable-address). Extend OpenDataset (types.rs) with an optional VSAM open-state field WITHOUT breaking the sequential path or object-safety; the VSAM open selects the backend from the cluster VsamType, reusing existing locator resolution + Volume Online check. Keep every signature object-safe. If impl_io.rs would exceed 400 non-test lines, extract the VSAM record path into dataset_access/impl_vsam.rs (new) with a mod line in dataset_access/mod.rs.

Rewrite the two deferral tests in dataset_access/impl_io_tests.rs: point_on_ksds_returns_not_yet_wired -> a KSDS keyed read-after-write round-trip through point+put+get asserting codec/backend boundaries (not CRLF); point_relative_rrds_returns_not_yet_wired -> an RRDS point(Rrn) put/get round-trip plus an RRN-0 BadPositioner assertion. Add a browse/sequential-order read test and (if exposed) a KSDS alt-index test. Each test // Validates: Requirement 34.1/34.2/35.3. Split new VSAM tests into a sibling (impl_vsam_tests.rs + mod line) if nearing ~200 lines. Keep the sequential tests in impl_access_tests.rs passing unchanged.

Update doc comments (trait_def.rs get/put/point # Errors; mod.rs/impl_io.rs headers) that call the VSAM op deferred-to-RC.B.7 to describe the now-concrete behaviour. If DatasetError::NotYetWired has no remaining producer, keep it (non_exhaustive, harmless) with an updated note OR remove it ONLY if clippy -D warnings flags it dead without breaking other matches. All text ASCII.

Run the scoped checks for ff-dscatalog (fmt, check --all-targets, clippy -D warnings, test), read each log, fix and re-run until clean. Set this FEAT status completed and record anything FEAT-002/003 need (e.g. new module names, whether NotYetWired was kept) in findings.

SIGNATURES: VsamBackend::open_for(root:&Path, dataset_id:Uuid, vsam_type:VsamType, params:&VsamParams)->Result<Self,VsamError>; typed methods get_keyed/put_keyed/delete_keyed/browse_from/lookup_alternate/add_alternate_index/rebuild_alternate_index/get_relative/put_relative/delete_relative/append_entry/get_address/sequential/vsam_type. CatalogVsamService::new(root)->Self implements the reconciled VsamService trait (open->VsamHandle in an internal handle map; get/put/delete dispatch keyed vs relative/append by VsamType; start_browse/next_record/end_browse iterate a materialised list; define_aix/build_index over KSDS alt-index else UnsupportedOperation). DatasetAccess wiring: OpenDataset gained a pub(crate) `vsam: Option<VsamOpen>` field (VsamOpen { vsam_type, backend: Arc<VsamBackend>, position: Option<Positioner> }) in types.rs; CatalogDatasetAccess gained `vsam_root: PathBuf` plus a new ctor `with_vsam_root(provider, registry, vsam_root)` (plain `new` derives a temp vsam_root; `in_memory` unchanged). New public entry point `CatalogDatasetAccess::open_vsam(&self, handle, vsam_type, params, intent)->Result<OpenDataset,DatasetError>` reuses resolve_locator for the Volume Online check then provisions a VsamBackend keyed by a deterministic FNV-1a UUID of the DSN. point/get/put in impl_io.rs delegate to point_vsam/get_vsam/put_vsam when open.vsam.is_some(); point rejects RRN 0 and type-mismatched positioners with DatasetError::BadPositioner. ESDS stable address of first record is 8 (DATA_MAGIC length) -- impl_vsam_tests relies on that documented constant. NotYetWired KEPT: DatasetError::NotYetWired is retained (no remaining producer; #[non_exhaustive] enum, kept for future deferred ops with an updated doc note) -- clippy -D warnings is clean with it retained. No public-trait widening; _assert_object_safe(&dyn DatasetAccess) still compiles and a new impl_vsam_tests test drives point/get/put through &dyn DatasetAccess. VSAM remains VsamCluster/VsamType, Dsorg still has exactly PS/PO/GDG.
